title: Sauce action program
description: A sequence of protocol actions that compiles to one Sauce program executing on one chain. Amounts are base-10 strings. A token is a registry symbol ("USDC", or a tokenized stock's, its issuer's ticker: "SPCXc") or an address, and a protocol contract a namespace reference ("UniswapV3.Factory") or an address; a name resolves on the chain the program is compiled for, so a document with no chainId compiles for any chain where its names exist. Beyond this schema, a program must satisfy: every address with mixed-case hex carries a valid EIP-55 checksum; every amount fits its declared width; a first action that takes an amount sets `amount`; an amountRef names a saveOutputAs set by an earlier action, and is not combined with `amount`; argument names are unique; the value of every balanceOf/nativeBalance/argument action is read; and every token symbol and namespace reference exists on the chain it is compiled for.

$schema.description: The schema this document declares; ignored.

chainId.description: The chain the document is written for; compiling it for another is refused. Leave it out of a document that names its tokens and contracts: it then compiles for any chain where those names exist, the chain chosen when it is compiled.

address.description: An address: 0x + 40 hex digits. A mixed-case address must carry a valid EIP-55 checksum.

tokenSymbol.description: A registry token symbol, as a Sauce program writes it: "USDC", "WETH", or a tokenized stock's, which is its issuer's ticker ("SPCXc", "TSLAon", "bTSLA"). It resolves on the chain the program is compiled for; a chain that does not register it refuses the program, naming the chain and the symbol. `sauce globals --chain <chain> --tokens` lists them, and `--stocks` the chain's stock tokens.

contractName.description: A protocol contract by namespace, as a Sauce program writes it: "UniswapV3.Factory", "BalancerV2.Vault", "UniswapV4.PoolManager". It resolves on the chain the program is compiled for; a chain without it refuses the program. `sauce globals --chain <chain> --protocols` lists them.

token.description: A token: a registry symbol, or an address.

tokenOrNative.description: A token: a registry symbol, an address, or "native" for the native currency, which the venue keys as the zero address.

contract.description: A protocol contract: a namespace reference, or an address.

tokenContract.description: A contract that is also a token (WETH, wstETH): a registry symbol, a namespace reference, or an address.

recipient.description: An address, or "self" for the executing Pot.

remoteRecipient.description: An address, or a 32-byte account on a non-EVM destination (0x + 64 hex digits).

bytes.description: 0x-prefixed hex bytes, an even number of digits.

identifier.description: A name that becomes a local variable in the emitted SauceScript.

action_uniswapV2Swap.title: uniswapV2Swap
action_uniswapV2Swap.description: Swaps through one Uniswap V2 pair (or a fork's), priced from its reserves and paid by a push. Calls @sauce/router uniswapV2: pair.getReserves, an ERC-20 transfer to the pair, pair.swap. Give exactly one of: pool; factory.

amount.description: The amount this action spends. Omit it (and amountRef) to spend the previous action's output.

pool.description: the pair; or leave it out and give `factory`

factory.description: instead of `pool`: a Uniswap V2-style factory ("UniswapV2.Factory"), whose getPair(tokenIn, tokenOut) is the pair; the program reads it from the factory on chain and reverts if there is none

tokenIn.description: the token sold, pushed to the pair

tokenOut.description: the token bought; the direction is the pair's sort order

feePpm.description: the pair's LP fee in parts per million; absent or 0 is 3000 (0.30%), PancakeSwap V2 is 2500

amountOutMin.description: the least output accepted; the venue reverts below it

recipient.description: receives the output when no later action spends it; `"self"` keeps it in the Pot

amountRef.description: Spend the output an earlier action saved under this name.

saveOutputAs.description: Save this action's output under a name later actions can reference.
